title: Green Fee-Free Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists the Green Fee-Free Account core specifications: $22.50 monthly maintenance fee waived with a $150 minimum daily balance, $0.00/month paper statements, 0% APY, $15.00 returned-item fee for unpaid checks, and $12.50 per incoming domestic wire. It also sets a $3,000/day debit card purchase limit.
